page.overview:
What is Last Bridge?

The Last Bridge was an ancient stone bridge that crossed the river Hoarwell along the East-West Road. The bridge and the river marked the western boundary of the Trollshaws.

Glorfindel attacked three Nazgûl guarding the bridge on October 11 TA 3018, leaving a green beryl in the road to signal his passage.
